value: This article by Marco Arment showcases his current app offerings, designed for iOS and Mac users. It highlights Overcast, a full-featured yet user-friendly podcast player for iOS devices, which stands out with innovative features like Smart Speed and Voice Boost, available for free with optional patronage. Also presented is Quitter, a free Mac app inspired by Arment's Automatic Social Discipline method, which automatically hides or quits applications after periods of inactivity to help users minimize digital distractions from apps like social media or email. Arment notes that while traditional support is not offered, feedback is welcomed via Twitter.
